| description = The Swarm Mother is an elusive beetle that spawns accompanied by an army of low level [[a swarmling|swarmlings]] only for the duration of [[Bertoxxulous]]'s Plague event during Velious. Her respawn time is set at spawn instead of death, meaning as long as you know one time you can calculate any future spawn for that zone as there is no variance due to time alive. Every respawn is accompanied by the zone-wide message '''a farmer shouts 'Run for your lives, the swarm is coming! Karana save us from the curse of Bertoxxulous!''''

In [[West Karana]], The Swarm Mother spawns at -3200, -4420 with a respawn timer of 3 hours 12 minutes and 12 seconds.

In [[North Karana]], The Swarm Mother spawns at -640, 2170 with a respawn timer of 3 hours and 36 minutes.
